Aggregated Meta snapshot fixture (`snapshot.json`). Schema and field types: `docs/meta-snapshot.md` and `utils/metaTypes.ts`. Parse with `parseMetaSnapshotPayload` from `utils/metaSnapshot.ts`. Do not serve this fixture on live pages. Playwright (`NUXT_E2E_SEED`) may load it into a local/CI database so `/meta` e2e can exercise a filled spec page. Display strings use `label`; reserved keys `name`, `realm`, and `character` are not allowed in the payload.
